title: 第25章 打破龙象规则强大的不死帝族第26章 鸣响观玄钟战天塔的隐藏禁制
content_zh:
“龙力？”林玄大感意外。
按照龙象阶梯的规则限制，玄气境武者应该只能显化出象影才对。
猎十七为何能显化出龙影？
“忘了告诉林老弟，不死帝族的修行路数跟咱们不同，能在玄气境显化出龙力虚影！”
向天行的声音传入耳中，林玄心下了然。
不死帝族的来历非常神秘，修行法门也与一般武者大相径庭，某种程度上能够打破龙象阶梯的规则限制。
昂！
黑龙虚影发出一声霸气的咆哮，猎十七那漆黑的拳头加速轰击而来。
林玄抬掌猛击，上方显化出一百头金象虚影。
“百象对一龙？不好！”
向天行脸色立变！
他本以为林玄会全力出手迎战猎十七，没想到只动用了跟对方相等的力量。
按照龙象阶梯的规则，百象为一龙，一龙即百象。
双方的力量看似对等，实则不然！
不死帝族的力量并不完全受龙象阶梯的限制，看似对等的碰撞中会占据绝对上风，具备碾压般的优势。
林玄如此大意，怕是要吃亏了。
轰！
不出所料，林玄这一掌果然落在下风，被猎十七一拳震退数丈！
“不死帝族的实力不能用常理来衡量，你们的力量看似对等，实则有着隐藏的差距！”
向天行大声警示道，表情异常凝重。

看起来，林玄果然不是猎十七的对手，给不了他任何惊喜。
如林玄这般妖孽都被轻松碾压，整个大炎皇朝还有什么人能撼动猎十七？
也许战天榜银榜头名的位置，再过一万年也未必能有变化吧！
向天行的心中，涌起一阵绝望！
虽然林玄还有一部分隐藏的实力，但他觉得没什么用。
因为猎十七也没有使出全力。
“不死帝族的力量果然能打破龙象阶梯的规则，再来！”
林玄被震退之后，非但没有退缩和沮丧，反而兴奋起来。
没错！
他要的就是这种感觉！
向天行虽强，却给不了他真正的威胁。
而在猎十七面前，他感受到了强大的压迫，内心的战意也开始激发！
轰！
林玄发动反击，隔空一掌拍向对手。
一百二十头金象虚影在他上方显化。
刚才正是凭借这种力量击败了向天行，此刻面对猎十七，又会是什么局面？
向天行比他还紧张！
content_en:
"Dragon power?" Lin Xuan was greatly surprised.
According to the rules of the Dragon-Elephant Staircase, a Xuan Qi realm warrior should only be able to manifest an elephant shadow.
Why can Hunter Seventeen manifest the dragon shadow?
"I forgot to tell Brother Lin that the Immortal Emperor Clan's cultivation method is different from ours, and they can manifest the phantom of dragon power in the profound energy realm!"
Lin Xuan's heart changed when Xiang Tianxing's voice reached his ears.
The origins of the Undead Emperor Clan are very mysterious, and their practice methods are also very different from those of ordinary warriors. To some extent, they can break the rules and restrictions of the Dragon Elephant Ladder.
hold head high!
The black dragon shadow let out a domineering roar, and Hunter Seventeen's dark fist accelerated and bombarded him.
Lin Xuan raised his palm and struck hard, and a hundred golden elephants appeared above him.
"A hundred elephants versus a dragon? Not good!"
Xiang Tianxing’s expression immediately changed!
He originally thought that Lin Xuan would attack Hunter Shiqi with all his strength, but he didn't expect that he would only use the same strength as the opponent.
According to the rules of the dragon-elephant ladder, one hundred elephants is one dragon, and one dragon is one hundred elephants.
The power of both sides seems to be equal, but in fact it is not!
The power of the Undead Emperor Clan is not completely limited by the Dragon-Elephant Staircase. In a seemingly equal collision, they will have the absolute upper hand, with a crushing advantage.
Lin Xuan was so careless that he might suffer a loss.
boom!
As expected, Lin Xuan's palm was at a disadvantage, and he was knocked back several feet by Hunter Shiqi's punch!
"The strength of the Undead Imperial Clan cannot be measured by common sense. Your strength seems to be equal, but in fact there is a hidden gap!"
Xiang Tianxing warned loudly, his expression extremely solemn.
It seemed that Lin Xuan was no match for Lie Qi and could not give him any surprises.
A monster like Lin Xuan was easily crushed. Who else in the entire Great Yan Dynasty could shake Hunter Shiqi?
Perhaps the position at the top of the Silver List on the Zhantian List may not change in another ten thousand years!
A burst of despair surged in Xiang Tianxing's heart!
Although Lin Xuan still had some hidden strength, he felt it was of no use.
Because Lie Qi didn’t use his full strength.
"The power of the Undead Imperial Clan can indeed break the rules of the Dragon Elephant Staircase, come again!"
After Lin Xuan was knocked back, instead of shrinking and being depressed, he became excited.
That's right!
This is what he wants!
Although Xiang Tianxing is strong, he cannot give him a real threat.
But in front of Lie Shiqi, he felt strong oppression, and his inner fighting spirit began to arouse!
boom!
Lin Xuan launched a counterattack and slapped his opponent with a palm from the air.
One hundred and twenty golden elephants appeared above him.
It was with this kind of power that he defeated Xiang Tianxing just now. What would happen now when he faced Hunter Seventeen?
Xiang Tianxing is even more nervous than him!
